checks.subject: CMD13 command eye
checks.details: Native CMD13 RCA<<16/R1/AC with mmc_wait_for_cmd(...,0), equivalent to core native __mmc_send_status zero-retry path. R1_STATUS plus explicit SWITCH_ERROR, READY_FOR_DATA and TRAN required. CRC-valid protocol/state failure returns EPROTO and is fatal.

checks.subject: EXT_CSD reference
checks.details: Exactly26 core read-only fields, same offsets and decoded low-speed card->ext_csd values; fresh512B allocation and DMA poison each trial; current HS_TIMING includes selected drive strength and BUS_WIDTH must equal6 without enhanced-strobe bit.

checks.subject: DS transfer and recovery
checks.details: Command center held fixed, mandatory per-trial DMA stop and ownership/IDST guard retained. Error classifier is restricted to read-only tuning. CMD8 failure issues explicit zero-retry CMD12 because core mmc_send_abort_tuning(CMD8) is a no-op. Post-abort fatal command/FIFO/controller errors terminate tuning.

checks.subject: Core transition states
checks.details: Initial HS200->HS->HS400 and retune HS400->DDR52->HS->HS200->HS400 paths match core. DDR52 is transient only, data rejected. Fixed8bit/1.8V, HS400 independent valid/frequency state; ordinary data gated until successful tuning, non-data protocol commands allowed.

checks.subject: Register policy
checks.details: HS400 genericCTRL.DDR clear, NTSR31/0 clear, EDSD31 set, CSDC6, CMD180/DATA90, module2x/div0. DDR8 transient CTRL.DDR set, DATA180, EDSD0, CSDC3, module4x/div1 and50MHz seed25. Existing sharedPLL/rail writes remain absent.

checks.subject: Scan and failure boundaries
checks.details: Separate64tap command andDS scans,20successful trials/tap, minimum12 linear window,16center confirmations.30s soft deadline each eye, command calls bounded. FinalCMD13 beforehs400_valid. Failure clearsvalid, stopsDMA/clock and setsios_error.

checks.subject: Build and host tests
checks.details: ActualC ASan/UBSan HS400 policy/comparator/status/error tests;26RO bindings checked againstcore; prior HS200 classifier and2080linearwindow testsPASS. ARM64 module CC/MODPOST/LD succeeded againstfrozenv23 kernel tree.

limits: Review and compilation do not establish electrical HS400 timing or board acceptance.
HS400100MHz and200MHz require distinct one-shot boot/tuning/integrity/health evidence before any default promotion.
Finite scans and register readback do not measure analog timing margins or DLL calibration.
CMD13 status and26RO EXT_CSD comparisons are bounded read-only checks; ordinary storage integrity needs a separate scratch-file phase.
v23 accepted HS200 source and v16 persistent fallback remain separate frozen states.
